title: 第十一章 疯子还得更疯的人压第十二章 问她吧
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
外套很小，拎着没什么重量，月白色调，袖口和衣襟滚着细窄的淡金色包边。
不是贴身穿的衣服，但那股气息并不弱，拿衣服的手都隐隐觉得有什么萦绕了过来。
“谢了。”
裴殷手指紧了紧，收回目光。
外套往肩上一搭，他心不在焉地走出别墅。
他们几个分配到的别墅离得很近，另外几个人有事耽搁，还没入学。
开学两周，今天是他第三次来凌厌执这里，自认为来往没有跟盛越那样密切。
但他没想到盛越会在门外等他。
裴殷朝他走过去，“我还以为你走了。”
他笑容扬起，就听到盛越转头，警告道，“别动她。”
“简妤？”裴殷脚步微微顿了顿，嘴角的笑意却没有落下，“凌厌执那个家伙没玩腻之前，我哪敢动她？”
他摸了摸脖子，上头还有赤蛇咬过的余痛。
遭罪。
“我该感谢他没叫赤蛇放毒，毒死我。”
察觉到自己态度不好，盛越眼睛看向别处。
他隐晦地暗示，“这些年，我们家族往研究所投进去那么多，也没见他们研究出来什么有用的东西。”
裴殷不蠢，明白他意有所指。
他笑容消失，“别告诉我，你也看上她了？”
他咧嘴笑了，故意刺激，“等一个是等，等两个也是等，大不了，凌厌执玩腻了，我再把她给你送过去。”
裴殷觑着盛越，看他反应，试探得云淡风轻，“等你们两个都玩够了，再给我研究也不迟。”

他没打算真的送简妤去联盟研究所，联盟的人喜欢藏私，指不定送过去没几天，就悄摸玩死了。
屁用没有，张口闭口就是要钱，联盟供着，家族供着，他可不伺候。
“看在你们的份上，我可以不让别人碰她。”裴殷勾了勾唇，一瞬不瞬地盯着对方的表情，“我会亲自来。”
“你不是这样的人，没必要把自己说成那样。”盛越眼神似在隐忍，但转眼唇角扯平，显得毫无波澜。
裴殷嗤笑，“我就是这样的人，我只是还没来得及做，别把我想得太有素质。”
“你不会。”盛越侧头，情绪不明，“还是得提醒你一句，别玩过头了。你我的3，是因为我们只能达到3，凌厌执的3，是机器阈值最高只有3。”
盛越面色平静，“我劝你不要试探他的底线。”
眼前划过蓝光，机甲消失在空中。
“哼。”裴殷眼睑垂了几分，脑海中是简妤那张无辜清纯的小脸。
犹记得对方被自己说要送她去研究所吓到时，纤长如蝶翼般的睫毛，无助颤动。
冷白，孱弱，可怜。
“也不怪他们这样。”裴殷耸了耸肩，只当兄弟都沦陷了。
他可不止两个兄弟。
瞒着他们多没意思，有好玩的，怎么能不一起分享？
点开星脑，裴殷在群聊上停顿了几秒钟。
小疯子还得大疯子压。
content_en:
The coat is very small and doesn't weigh much when you carry it. It's moon white in color, with narrow pale gold edges on the cuffs and hem.
It wasn't clothes that were close-fitting, but the aura was not weak, and the hand holding the clothes felt like something was lingering.
"Thanks."
Pei Yin tightened his fingers and looked away.
Putting his coat on his shoulders, he walked out of the villa absentmindedly.
The villas they were assigned to were very close to each other, and a few others were delayed and had not yet entered school.
Two weeks into the school year, today was the third time he came to Ling Yanzhi's place. He thought he didn't have as close a relationship with Sheng Yue.
But he didn't expect Sheng Yue to be waiting for him outside the door.
Pei Yin walked towards him, "I thought you were gone."
He smiled and heard Sheng Yue turn his head and warn, "Don't touch her."
"Jian Yu?" Pei Yin paused slightly, but the smile on his lips did not fall. "How can I dare to touch her until that guy Ling Yanzhi gets tired of playing with her?"
He touched his neck, and there was still the lingering pain from the red snake bite.
Suffer.
"I should be grateful that he didn't ask the Red Snake to poison me."
Sensing that his attitude was bad, Sheng Yue looked away.
He hinted cryptically, "Our family has invested so much in research institutes over the years, but we haven't seen them come up with anything useful."
Pei Yin is not stupid and understands what he means.
His smile disappeared, "Don't tell me, you also have a crush on her?"
He grinned, deliberately provoking, "Waiting for one is waiting, and waiting for two is waiting. At worst, Ling Yanzhi gets tired of playing, and I will send her over to you again."
Pei Yin looked at Sheng Yue, watching his reaction, and said, "It won't be too late to study it for me after you two have had enough fun."
He had no intention of really sending Jian Yu to the Alliance Research Institute. People in the Alliance liked to hide their secrets, and they might have died secretly within a few days of sending her there.
It's no use, he just wants money. The alliance provides it, the family provides it, but he doesn't care.
"For your sake, I can prevent others from touching her." Pei Yin curled his lips and stared at the other person's expression for a moment, "I will do it myself."
"You are not such a person, there is no need to describe yourself as that." Sheng Yue's eyes seemed to be forbearing, but in a blink of an eye, the corners of his lips flattened, appearing calm.
Pei Yin sneered, "That's the kind of person I am. I just haven't had time to do it yet. Don't think of me as too qualified."
"You can't." Sheng Yue tilted his head, his emotions unclear, "I still have to remind you, don't overdo it. Your 3 and mine are because we can only reach 3. Ling Yanzhi's 3 is because the machine's highest threshold is only 3."
Sheng Yue looked calm, "I advise you not to test his bottom line."
A blue light flashed before his eyes, and the mecha disappeared into the air.
"Humph." Pei Yin's eyelids drooped a little, and in his mind was Jian Yu's innocent little face.
I still remember that when the other party was frightened by him saying that he would send her to a research institute, her eyelashes, as long as butterfly wings, trembled helplessly.
Cold and white, weak and pitiful.
"It's no wonder they are like this." Pei Yin shrugged, just thinking that the brothers had fallen.
He has more than two brothers.
It would be boring to hide it from them. There is something fun, why not share it together?
After clicking on Xingnao, Pei Yin paused in the group chat for a few seconds.
The little lunatic has to be suppressed by the big lunatic.
